item.title: Writing Documentation
item.description: Documents and blog posts Document pages focus on content. They omit the blog cover, author profile, publication date, tags, and sharing controls. Add a document Create a Markdown file under content/docs/, add its title, slug, weight, and menu.docs configuration, then write the document body in Markdown. Navigation Use Markdown headings to generate the table of contents on the right. The menu.docs fields control the document tree on the left.
